env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local
mkdir $WORK/bin

cd main
! logos build -p=1 -gcflags=example.com/diamonddep=-l -o $WORK/bin/diamond$GOEXE ./cmd
stderr 'ERROR \[capabilities::unauthorized_reflect\]'
stderr 'example\.com/diamonddep\.Init\(\) +at [^ ]+dep\.go:9'
stderr 'example\.com/diamonddep\.Short\(\) +at [^ ]+dep\.go:18'
stderr 'example\.com/diamonddep\.Sink\(\) +at [^ ]+dep\.go:20'
stderr 'reflect\.ValueOf\(\) +at [^ ]+value\.go:[1-9][0-9]*'
! stderr 'diamonddep\.(LongOnly|Extra)\('
cp stderr chain.txt
go run ../check.go chain.txt
stderr '^ok$'

-- main/go.mod --
module example.com/diamondmain

go 1.27

require example.com/diamonddep v0.0.0

replace example.com/diamonddep => ../dep

-- main/logos.toml --
[capabilities]
transitive_reflect = "deny"

-- main/cmd/main.lgo --

package main

import "example.com/diamonddep"

func main() { dep.Init() }

-- dep/go.mod --
module example.com/diamonddep

go 1.27

-- dep/dep.go --
// Copyright 2026 The Go Authors. All rights reserved.
// Use of this source code is governed by a BSD-style
// license that can be found in the LICENSE file.

package dep

import "reflect"

func Init() {
	LongOnly()
	Short()
}

func LongOnly() { Extra() }

func Extra() { Sink() }

func Short() { Sink() }

func Sink() { println(reflect.ValueOf(1).IsValid()) }

-- check.go --
// Copyright 2026 The Go Authors. All rights reserved.
// Use of this source code is governed by a BSD-style
// license that can be found in the LICENSE file.

package main

import (
	"os"
	"regexp"
	"strings"
)

func main() {
	data, err := os.ReadFile(os.Args[1])
	if err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
	frame := regexp.MustCompile(`^ +[0-9]+\. `)
	located := regexp.MustCompile(`\(\) +at .+:[1-9][0-9]*$`)
	count := 0
	for _, line := range strings.Split(string(data), "\n") {
		if frame.MatchString(line) {
			if !located.MatchString(line) {
				panic(line)
			}
			count++
		}
	}
	if count == 0 {
		panic(count)
	}
	println("ok")
}
